params.body:
## What changes

Garage users' rights follow the garage's modules instead of roles 3/4/5, behind a new rollout flag `module_rights` that starts at stage `dealers` with StockCars (dealer 4) only. Nothing changes for any other garage until a name is added on Beheer > Functies.

The model is the one the dry run measured (`App\Support\GarageRights`, #876/#879):

- base set for every garage with at least one module (what roles 3 and 4 both grant, including `user`, so role-5 garages gain managing their own employees);
- dealer set with `module_1` (role 3 only, plus `export` and `merchant`);
- trader set with `module_2` (role 4 only);
- gated keys (transport, dealer-insights) stay decided by their Gate; `dealer` (admin only) and `verhicle` (dead) are not decided by the model; for all of these the role's row is carried unchanged;
- roles 1, 6, 7 and 8, and every garage outside the flag: exactly today's rights.

### Add, edit and delete

Per key, the flags are the union (OR) over roles 3, 4 and 5 of the add/edit/delete flags on rows with view = 1 (`GarageRights::unionOfFlags`, `rightsForModules`). So no garage role loses a flag it had on a menu, and a flag none of the three garage roles has on a key is never switched on (no garage gains a delete it never had). A role that lacked a flag another garage role had on the same key does gain it: one answer per key instead of three. The dry run counted keys, not flags, so the flags are pinned by the new test.

### Where it is enforced

- `AccessRights::forUser` builds the module rights for a role 3/4/5 user whose garage the flag includes; the `access` middleware reads them as before.
- `Menu::scopeVisibleTo` shows an item without an `ability` when its key is in those rights, so menu and routes give the same answer.
- The session stamp (R P2-4.9) carries, for such users, the garage's two switches and whether the flag applies. The switches are cached per garage for 60 seconds and shared by the rights, the stamp and the stopped check (`GarageRights::switches`), so they never disagree. A module switch applies within the minute without a new sign-in, and immediately after the switch in the dealer list (`update_module` forgets the garage's cache key).

### Stopped customer

Both modules off, flag on, role 3/4/5: no menus, and every page behind the login (`auth` groups in `routes/web.php` and `_partials/Auth.php`, via the new `garage.active` middleware) redirects to `account.stopped`: one standalone page in nl/fr/en/de that says the account is not active, with the support address the app already uses (`config('variable.support_email')`, contact@stocklistdealer.eu) and a sign-out link. JSON requests get 403. Anybody else opening that page goes to the dashboard. An administrator working inside the account through delegation is never sent there; he works with the role's rights as before, and `delegation.stop` stays open.

### Gates

`act-as-dealer` (module_1) and `act-as-trader` (module_2) in `AuthServiceProvider`, true for administrators. Nothing asks them yet.

## How an administrator tests it at StockCars

The flag only affects users of roles 3/4/5, so an administrator attached to dealer 4 sees no change on his own account. Test through delegation: the "Inloggen als" button next to a StockCars user (the user list, or the users tab of the StockCars sheet; `user.index.loginas`), or "Inloggen als" on the StockCars row of the dealer list (`dealer.index.enter`). While delegated, the rights are the delegated user's and the modules decide; "Terug naar mijn account" (`delegation.stop`) rebuilds the administrator's own rights and stamp. StockCars has three real role-5 users; the flag at `dealers [4]` changes their menus too, which is intended.

## Widening the flag

Beheer > Functies > "Menu's volgen de modules van de garage": add garages at stage "Gekozen dealers", or set "Iedereen". Or in tinker: `App\Support\Features::set('module_rights', 'dealers', [4, ...])`. Every change is recorded in `feature_flag_changes` and takes effect within the minute. At `everyone`, the dry run says: 301 garages unchanged, 121 gain only, 0 active garages lose anything, 6 dormant role-5 garages with only module_2 lose export/merchant, 114 garages with both modules off become stopped customers.

## Follow-up: the scattered module checks

Not replaced here. Checks on the signed-in user's own garage (candidates for the two Gates):

- `app/Http/Controllers/HomeController.php:33` (module_1)
- `app/Http/Controllers/Vehicle/OwnStockController.php:278` (module_1)
- `resources/views/layouts/navigation.blade.php:68-70` (trader = module_1 off, via `Dealer` helpers)
- `resources/views/stocklist/_tabs/buybox.blade.php:98` (module_1)
- `resources/views/ownstock/_type_veld.blade.php:11`, `ownstock/_tabs/general.blade.php:41`, `livewire/vehicle-form.blade.php:304` (module_1 and module_2)
- `resources/views/ownstock/_wagen_rij.blade.php:410`, `worklist/widgets/1.blade.php:65`, `worklist/widgets/2.blade.php:62` (module_2, column width)
- `app/Models/Settings/Dealer.php:240-262` (helpers `isTrader` and friends)
- `resources/views/settings/dealer/_tabs/form.blade.php:250,307,362` (the sheet's sections per module)

Queries about other garages (who receives bidding mails, who is listed as a colleague, whose cars are in the shared stock); these filter data and stay as column checks: `app/Http/Helpers/MailHelper.php:40,58,83`, `app/Http/Helpers/Enumeration.php:180,233,237`, `app/Repositories/Settings/DealerRepository.php:38,74`, `app/Livewire/StocklistBrowser.php:581,842`, `app/Models/Vehicle/Vehicle.php:959`, `app/Repositories/OwnStock/VehicleRepository.php:865`, `app/Repositories/Export/ExportVehicleRepository.php:176`, `app/Http/Middleware/RequireDealerPackage.php`. Admin screens and reports: `DealerController`, `settings/dealer/index.blade.php`, `InsightsRepository`, `dealerExcelResource`, `IntegrationChecks`, `RightsDryRunCommand`, and the commands `DailyExports`, `DealerHasOpenWorklistItemsCommand`, `IntegrationSmoke`.

## Business rules

New in P2-4: R P2-4.10 (rights follow the garage's modules, staged, StockCars first), R P2-4.11 (stopped customer), R P2-4.12 (the two Gates). R P2-4.2 now points at P2-4.10 for roles 3/4/5. No renumbering.

## Tests

`RightsFollowTheGarageModulesTest` (18 tests): the fixture of garages (M1 only, M2 only, both, none; roles 3/4/5) gives the model's target sets with the flag on and exactly today's role rights with it off; M1 = base + dealer, M2 = base + trader, both = all, none = stopped page; role 5 gains `user`; union of flags; roles 1/6/7/8 unchanged; a module switch changes the rights after the stamp window and at once after the switch; the flag itself is in the stamp; transport and dealer-insights still by their Gates; the access middleware sends an M2-only role-5 user from `offer.index` to the dashboard; the menu follows; the stopped page, its four languages, nobody else caught; delegation into a flagged garage sees the trader set without `offer` and leaving restores the admin rights; the way back out of a stopped account stays open; the Gates.

Locally: full suite 2542 tests green, PHPStan no errors, pint on the new files, `bin/rules-sources` no problems.
params.title: Rights follow the garage's modules, behind a staged flag
